case_title: WELLINTON SMITH JR VS. SAN FRANCISCO HOUSING AUTHORITY

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $6,500.00 FILED BY SMITH JR, WELLINTON AS TO DEFENDANT SAN FRANCISCO HOUSING AUTHORITY ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUL-17-2017 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506

REQUEST TO WAIVE COURT FEES AND COSTS PURSUANT TO G.C. 68633, CRC 3.51, 8.26, AND 8.818 (CONFIDENTIAL) FILED BY PLAINTIFF SMITH JR, WELLINTON ORDER FOR WAIVER OF COURT FEES AND COSTS GRANTED PURSUANT TO G.C. 68634 (E), CRC 3.52
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF NO FEE FOR SERVICE: WAIVER SERVED MAY-25-2017, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT SAN FRANCISCO HOUSING AUTHORITY

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF JUL-17-2017 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF JUL-17-2017 BY DONALD S. MITCHELL. PLAINTIFF WELLINTON SMITH SR. IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT SAN FRANCISCO HOUSING AUTHORITY IS NOT PRESENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL; CLERK: J. MURPHY; NOT REPORTED. (506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUL-17-2017 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF SMITH JR, WELLINTON IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT SAN FRANCISCO HOUSING AUTHORITY ALTHOUGH PLAINTIFF HAS WAITED ON THE EMERGENCY TRANSFER LIST FOR OVER A YEAR FOR A DIFFERENT HOUSING UNIT, PLAINTIFF HAS NOT SUFFERED ANY MONETARY LOSS AND COMPENSATION FOR "PAIN AND SUFFERING" IS NOT AWARDABLE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
